The '''''Valor''-class cruiser''' served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At least some of the cruisers are produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="Kuat" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Torcapship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Valor''-class cruisers in orbit]]
The ship design had a bulbous center section, with gun batteries covering the front, sides and stern, seven thrusters located on a ventral tower and a command tower on the dorsal side. Lining the sides of each ship were several hangars.<ref name="RCS" /> In addition, at least one hangar was located on the dorsal hull, facing the "valley" in the middle of the craft.<ref name="TVW">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20110312|text=Taral V Developer Walkthrough}}</ref> The Capital Ship typically followed the Republic color scheme with red stripes on white hulls, but could be given other colors as well.<ref name="RCS">{{TORweb|url=media/concepts/republic-capitol-ship|text=Concept Art &ndash; Republic Capitol Ship|nolive=1}}</ref>

The ship class served as the heaviest and most powerful warship in the Republic fleet, allowing it to match the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] in terms of size and firepower but it was only armored where needed, allowing it to be faster and more agile than the ''Harrower''. Due to their extremely high production cost, these valuable ships were largely resigned to defensive operations, typically serving as flagships of the Republic Fleet in charge of planetary defense against Imperial attacks and striking Imperial assets across the galaxy.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

====Complement====
Due to their relative rarity and strategic importance, Valor-class cruisers are manned almost exclusively by veteran crews with many years of combat experience.<ref name=":0" />

==History==
[[File:Horusetbattle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Republic ships attack a Sith fleet near Korriban.]]
Several of these ships were involved in fighting during the Great Galactic War, as part of a task force that [[Battle over Korriban|attacked]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="BOTE3" /> They later saw combat in the following Cold War.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] served on board the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']], flagship of the [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] and directed a group of Republic adventurers from the ship during a [[Battle of Taral V|raid]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Taral V Imperial fortress|compound]] of [[Taral V]].<ref name="TVW" />

During the Cold War, the ''Telos'' was part of the Republic task force to rescue Jedi Master [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] from the Maelstrom Prison along with a Republic strike team. After Revan's release at least two of these ships were part of the Republic blockade protecting the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] from Imperial attack until the Emperor ordered an attack on the space station.

The ''[[Allusis]]'', named after [[Great Galactic War]] hero [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Belth Allusis]], was captured by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces. A strike team was created and the ship was boarded by a launched boarding pod from a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Galactic War]], a ''Valor''-class named the [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']] commanded by Admiral [[Dabrin]] served as the Republic flagship, being captured by Imperial forces led by Jedi Master [[Warren Sedoru]] who had been turned into the Emperor's slave. Along with the knowledge of Republic tactics and fleet positions, the Empire made the ''Valiant'' into an unstoppable weapon that could cripple the Republic Fleet. The [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] along with allies boarded the flagship and defeated the fallen Jedi as well as saving Admiral Dabrin.

During the renewed conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] many ''Valor''-class warships were deployed against the Empire in several battlefields including [[Battle of Corellia|Corellia]], [[Battle of Ilum|Ilum]] and in several schisms as well as the Republic redoubled its efforts to defeat the Sith Empire. A number of these warships would also go on to do what was believed impossible by [[Dromund Kaas operation|assaulting]] the Imperial Capital itself.

==Behind the scenes==
A Valor-class cruiser appeared in the canon comic [[Star Wars (2020) 26|''Star Wars'' (2020) 26]], where a traced image of the vessel flipped backwards appeared as a background ship used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]].<ref name="Star Wars 26">[[Star Wars (2020) 26|''Star Wars'' (2020) 26]]</ref> Republic guilds can purchase their own Valor-class cruiser as a "Guild Flagship" as part of the "Galactic Strongholds" digital expansion.<ref name="SWTOR GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>
